manufacturer: Beijing SonoPhotoNano Medical Technology Co., Ltd.
mechanism: RGD-targeted PEG-Cy7 near-infrared fluorescent molecular probe intended for intraoperative fluorescence imaging of colorectal cancer; final marketed composition and target claims remain investigational.
development_status: ClinicalTrials.gov lists a Phase 1, single-center, single-blind, randomized study as not yet recruiting, with an estimated 32 participants, estimated start date of 2024-12-17, and estimated primary completion date of 2026-04-10.
clinical_summary: The trial is designed to evaluate safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetics of single-dose IV SPN01 in healthy volunteers and colorectal cancer surgery patients, with exploratory endpoints for preliminary efficacy and intraoperative tumor imaging effects. No SPN01 clinical results are posted.
safety_summary: No SPN01 human safety results are posted. The trial's primary safety endpoint includes adverse events, clinical labs, local safety assessments, vital signs, ECG, and physical exams through 24 hours after dosing. Optical imaging analog Cytalux carries infusion-reaction, misinterpretation, embryo-fetal toxicity, and aggregation/infusion-reaction warnings.

Evidence review for tumor-detection yield, false positives, and false negatives before broad coverage
evidence_gaps: No SPN01 clinical efficacy or safety results are posted.

expected_launch_window.method: Conservative timing based on Phase 1 status, no posted results, no direct regulatory filing signal, and possible stale recruiting status.
expected_launch_window.explanation: A targeted surgical imaging agent could follow a shorter diagnostic path than chronic oncology drugs, but SPN01 has only an early Phase 1 safety/PK study and no posted detection-performance data. A launch before 2031 is not supportable from available sources.

annual_cost_range.method: Used Cytalux as the closest approved NIR intraoperative optical imaging analog and applied the published $3,315 payment amount as a per-patient, one-time annual cost proxy.
annual_cost_range.explanation: SPN01 is given as a single pre-surgical IV dose in the colorectal cancer arm. No direct SPN01 price was found, so annual per-patient exposure is modeled as one imaging-agent use rather than recurring therapy.

clinical_differentiation.method: Weighted targeted colorectal intraoperative imaging concept against absence of clinical performance data.
clinical_differentiation.explanation: RGD/Cy7 targeted fluorescence could be differentiated versus non-targeted dyes if it improves colorectal tumor visualization, but current evidence is limited to Phase 1 safety/PK and exploratory imaging endpoints.

budget_impact.method: Considered one-time surgical use, early-stage uncertainty, and low analog per-patient cost relative to systemic oncology therapies.
budget_impact.explanation: Even if approved, the main spend driver would be eligible colorectal surgeries using compatible NIR systems, not chronic treatment duration.

disruption_risk.method: Assessed clinical maturity, operational requirements, and payer-control options.
disruption_risk.explanation: The asset is early-stage with no posted results. Adoption would require surgical workflow and compatible imaging equipment, and payer disruption can be managed through medical-benefit criteria.

recommended_action.method: Matched action to Phase 1 evidence level, stale registry signal, and lack of pricing/regulatory disclosures.
recommended_action.explanation: Track trial status updates, posted results, China regulatory progress, and any payer-relevant detection-performance endpoints before preparing coverage operations.
